Cafe Latte.note: Fresh milk. Oat (gluten) or almond (tree nuts) milk are paid modifiers, not the base dish.

Cappuccino.note: Fresh milk; cocoa dust adds no allergen.

Mocha.note: Fresh milk; chocolate sauce with soy lecithin = soy.

Gula Melaka Latte.note: Fresh milk; gula melaka is palm sugar.

Hojicha Latte.note: Fresh milk; low caffeine, not caffeine-free.

Sparkling Yuzu.note: Honey rules out vegan. Caffeine-free, no alcohol.

Iced Chocolate.note: Fresh milk and whipped cream; soy lecithin.

Babyccino.note: Marshmallow with beef gelatine: not vegetarian (gelatine), halal per stated beef source (as v4 Panna Cotta, rule n) in a pork-free kitchen.

Eggs Benedict.note: Poached eggs, hollandaise (egg yolk, butter), English muffin = wheat. Beef bacon: pork-free, no alcohol.

Shakshuka.note: Eggs, feta, sourdough. Described as spicy (harissa). Merchant's vegetarian tag kept (rennet not stated).

Avocado Toast.note: Sourdough, poached egg, dukkah with hazelnuts (tree nuts) and sesame. Pinch of chilli flakes, stated mild.

Big Breakfast.note: Eggs; wheat rusk in the chicken sausage and sourdough = gluten; buttered toast = milk. Beef bacon, chicken sausage: no pork.

Granola Bowl.note: Oats = gluten; almonds = tree nuts; Greek yoghurt = milk; honey rules out vegan. Pumpkin seeds are not tree nuts.

Truffle Mushroom Toast.note: Chicken jus: sounds vegetarian but is not. Butter and ricotta = milk; sourdough = gluten.

Smoked Salmon Scramble.note: Eggs, cream, smoked salmon, sourdough. Capers: no sulphites stated.

Nasi Lemak Bowl.note: Wheat flour batter; belacan = crustaceans; ikan bilis = fish; peanuts; egg. Coconut milk is not milk. Described as spicy.

Vegan Tofu Scramble.note: Tofu = soy; sourdough = gluten. Stated no egg, no dairy.

Roasted Tomato Soup.note: Vegetable stock; sourdough on the side = gluten. No celery stated.

Chicken Pesto Panini.note: Cashew pesto = tree nuts (hidden); parmesan and mozzarella = milk; ciabatta = gluten.

Kouign-Amann.note: Wheat and butter; no egg stated.

Kaya Croissant.note: Butter croissant; kaya with eggs; coconut milk is not milk. Sold out (extra.json).

Banana Bread.note: Bread = wheat flour; eggs; brown butter; walnuts.

Burnt Cheesecake.note: Cream cheese, cream, eggs, a little wheat flour.

Tiramisu.note: Dark rum = alcohol, not halal (the pork-free branch may use alcohol). Savoiardi = wheat and egg; mascarpone; egg yolk.

Orange Almond Cake.note: Flourless, stated gluten-free; almonds; eggs; no dairy stated.

Vegan Chocolate Cake.note: Wheat flour; soy lecithin. Coconut oil is not a tree nut.
